sourceVersionPolicy: fixtureRevision identifies bytes only; actual documentId/version must be observed at each action. No assumed 0/1 host versions. Retry calls a new capture; edit after cancellation must produce r2 with its observed version.

fixtures.runtimeRequirement: Must observe .milkup-source-document-view and native large-file notice; size alone does not prove successful native open. Three SVG diagrams required; source fallback is failure.

scenarios.session: fresh isolated approved plugin profile per format
scenarios.require: Capture all native renderer dispatches; distinguish first output from genuinely first renderer invocation. Wait document ready, not an invented warm-up delay.

scenarios.session: same document and unchanged observed version as first successful output
scenarios.require: Repeat twice with distinct destinations; every output must have one actual diagram and no disabled renderer. No hidden re-enable or warm-up retry.
Three actual presentations, two identical sources with separate IDs/refs and one distinct source. No stale reuse, fragment swaps or partial fallback.
Three diagrams near beginning/middle/end across >256-line source windows; 300 body markers exactly once. This minimal window stress does not replace the 60000-line Large05 route.

Cancel observable preparation or native chooser; record exact achieved checkpoint. Assert no committed target. Edit through real editor, observe greater version and r2 source hash; retry captures r2 and never emits r1 labels. Preparation cancelled too late is NOT_EXERCISED, not PASS.

Use the original exact source for cold and repeated PrintToFile in the minimum matrix; require real diagram rather than previous source fallback. Other matrix fixtures cover HTML/A4/Letter. Preserve known PDF copy/search and long-block failures separately.

knownUnresolved: WebKit PDF original-codepoint mapping/copy-search failure; no normalization waiver.
Long table/code/list heading orphaning; retain existing boundary fixtures and failures.
Physical printer and non-Linux native checks not established by print-to-file.
artifactEvidenceRequired: Actual independently installed diagrams archive path/SHA/version/approval and enabled state before and after.
Binary SHA, actual saved output SHA, fixture SHA, runtime documentId/version and source observation method.
Renderer dispatch/deadline/completion/cancellation logs from activation through output; fallback warning list.
HTML exact saved bytes with SVG structure plus offline DOM/pixel review; PDF/print-to-file page raster and per-diagram visible node/edge review.
A failure is retained as its own run; later retries cannot overwrite it.

minimalMatrix.checkpoint: Record actual preparation/chooser checkpoint; too-late preparation cancellation is NOT_EXERCISED.

minimalMatrix.require: Native source-document view and explicit native large-file notice; all three diagrams and every body marker exactly once.

resources.expectation: Embed exact supported local image; only the original missing-local and remote paths may warn.
